services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Come enjoy a beautiful evening riding along the shoreline of Lake St. Clair and the Detroit River, these cruises are the best way to experience and make a Pure Michigan Summer memory! We offer these trips on our 31’ Tiara’s which have all the amenities & creature comforts you could want, especially if the weather decides to change. Departing from Jefferson Beach Marina during the summer months (June - Aug.) as well as from the St. Clair River (Sept.) We leisurely run the shoreline of Lake St. Clair to the Detroit River. Following it down stream along the Canadian side to the heart of downtown Detroit, where we take a short photo op and then head back along the Michigan side of the river,
